ops.h: Edema — algorithm (เล่มเหลือง)
ops.html:
• Localized (eg. Arm, leg)
    • Venous obstruction: DVT
    • Lymphatic obstruction: CA infiltration · Irradiation · Scar from trauma · Filariasis · Lymphatic hypoplasia (Milroy dz)
    • Other: Inflammation (Cellulitis, erysipelas) · Trauma (Sprain/Fracture)
  • Generalized
    • Heart failure ♡
    • Renal disease (ไต): Nephrotic syndrome · Glomerulonephritis · Renal failure with volume overload
    • Liver cirrhosis (GI)
    • Hypoalbuminemia (Nutrition): Protein-losing enteropathy · Malnutrition
    • Other: Hypothyroid · Drug (NSAIDs, Estrogen, CCB) · Idiopathic · High altitude
